title: Console UI: Suggestions detail drawer (savings breakdown, risk rationale, telemetry basis)
author: Nora Ahmed
body:
Implements the Suggestions detail drawer UI (opened from the Suggestions list) with the three core sections required for beta: (1) savings breakdown, (2) risk rationale, and (3) telemetry “basis of estimate”. This PR is UI-only (read-only beta); no “apply” actions are introduced. The drawer renders data coming from the Console BFF Suggestions endpoints (added in prior PRs), and is designed to be schema-tolerant (graceful empty states when any subsection is missing/unsupported). Design: DES-188.

User-facing behavior: Selecting a suggestion row opens a right-side drawer (responsive width) with a header (title, target scope chips for route/model/region, suggestion id copy action), followed by: Savings: shows estimated $/1M tokens delta and projected monthly impact, with a breakdown table by “before vs after” unit cost and a collapsible “assumptions” block. Includes copy clarifying that savings are estimates and may vary. Risk: renders a risk level chip (Low/Medium/High) and a rationale list (bullets) plus a short “why this was classified” paragraph; if rationale is absent, we show a generic fallback (“Risk level provided by Redwood Optimize; rationale unavailable”). Basis of estimate: shows the telemetry window used, baseline freshness, and input metrics (token volume, observed batch size distribution and/or cache hit-rate signals as applicable). Includes an explicit “Insufficient telemetry” state that explains what is missing and links to docs/help.

Implementation notes: New <SuggestionDetailDrawer /> composed of three section components: <SavingsBreakdown />, <RiskRationale />, <TelemetryBasis />. Number formatting is consistent with Console conventions (currency rounding, 2 decimals for $/1M tokens, integer rounding for monthly totals). The drawer uses focus trapping + ESC close + proper aria labeling; clicking outside closes unless a nested popover is open. Loading state: skeleton sections (header + 3 blocks). Error state: inline “couldn’t load details” with retry that refetches the detail endpoint.

Data contract expectations (UI side): savings_estimate_v1: expects delta_usd_per_million_tokens, projected_monthly_usd_delta, confidence_interval_80 (optional), and a breakdown array for line items. risk: expects risk_level and rationale_bullets (optional) plus assumptions (optional). telemetry_basis: expects window_start/window_end, baseline_last_updated_at, and a set of metrics keyed by recommendation type. NOTE: the UI tolerates missing confidence_interval_80 and missing telemetry_basis metrics, but will display a banner when the baseline is stale beyond the server-provided threshold.

Screenshots: Added to PR comments (see ‘UI preview’ comment) for: normal state (caching suggestion), batching suggestion, insufficient telemetry state, and high-risk example.

Out of scope / follow-ups: Phase 2 “apply” workflow, export/share link, and cross-linking to per-route dashboards. Analytics events for drawer open/close handled in PR-18690.

Testing: Unit tests for formatting + conditional rendering (savings present/absent, risk rationale absent, telemetry insufficient). Storybook stories for key states. Manual: verified keyboard navigation + screen reader labels.

Release note (internal): Adds the Suggestion detail drawer UI for the Suggestions beta (feature-flag gated).

review_conversation: Tessa Morgan (Design) 2026-01-31: The overall hierarchy matches DES-188. Two nits: (1) Please change “Guaranteed savings” to “Estimated savings” everywhere (including tooltip). (2) Basis section needs a one-liner explaining what it is in plain language.
Nora Ahmed (Author) 2026-01-31: Updated copy to “Estimated savings” and added a short intro line in Basis: “These numbers are derived from recent usage and metering signals.” Pushed in 1a0f5a9.

Jonas Weber (Applied ML) 2026-01-31: For risk rationale bullets: can we label them as “Signals considered” instead of implying causality? Also, if we show CI bounds, please add a note that it’s an 80% interval (not a guarantee).
Nora Ahmed (Author) 2026-01-31: Good call. Adjusted section label to “Signals considered” and appended “80% interval” to the confidence tooltip where present.

Svetlana Orlov (Design system) 2026-02-01: Drawer focus handling: tab order currently escapes to the page in my quick test. Can we enforce focus trap + ESC to close? Also ensure close button has aria-label.
Nora Ahmed (Author) 2026-02-01: Added focus trap + ESC close and aria-label on close. Also added a regression unit test around focus cycling in Drawer.test.tsx.

Chloe Martin (Eng) 2026-02-01: Looks good. One request: when telemetry basis is missing, avoid showing an empty table; render the “insufficient telemetry” card with actionable items (which signals are missing).
Nora Ahmed (Author) 2026-02-01: Implemented conditional rendering: missing basis -> show the card + list missing_fields if provided, else generic. Added tests for both paths.
Dylan Brooks (Eng lead) 2026-02-02: Approving. Please make sure we’re not blocking on any schema field that isn’t in the contract yet; the toleration/fallback approach you took seems right.
Tessa Morgan (Design) 2026-02-02: Approved after copy changes. Screens look aligned with mocks.
